description: Returns the Sun-sign horoscope Zodiacs publishes for a date: general, love or career for a day, or general for the week. With a birth date it adds a personal forecast for the week from that person's own chart, in dated lines. Each reading is dated and carries a "Reading confidence NN%" label that says how specific the details were, not the odds of an event. shareUrl is the link for sharing the reading. It fits a request for a daily or weekly horoscope or a reflective reading for a sign. A horoscope asked for with no sign named still belongs here: it opens with the sign left for the person to choose. Daily readings exist for the day before, the day of and the day after the current edition. Limits: no betting tips, sports picks, stock picks, investment timing, financial forecasts, election forecasts, health predictions or guaranteed outcomes, including when such a request mentions a horoscope. A request for one of those is not a request for this tool, not even as a first step: Zodiacs does not do this, and no horoscope is fetched for it. For a birth date under 18 there is no love or romance reading: the general reading stands in, with a note that says so. With no birth date it has no way to know the reader's age. It refuses a birth date less than 13 years ago. There is no horoscope for a named child under 13, meaning a particular child the request names or points to, such as someone's nine-year-old daughter, whatever the sign and with or without a birth date. A Sun sign on its own, with no name and no birth date, gets the general horoscope for that sign. Birth details are used for this answer only: never stored, logged or put in a link. Zodiacs sends no notifications and schedules nothing, so a reminder or a horoscope on a schedule is not a request for this tool either. Its results include a link to the sign-up page for the daily email.

birthDate.description: Optional: the person's birth date, for a personal forecast of their week from their own chart. Not stored.

birthTime.description: Optional birth time on the local clock; needs birthZone. Not stored.

birthZone.description: Optional: the birthplace's time zone, needed with birthTime. Not stored.

date.description: A date such as 2026-10-08. Leave it out for the person's today.

focus.description: For a daily reading: general (the default), love or career.

sign.description: Sun sign. Leave it out to let the person choose; never guess it.

zone.description: The person's time zone, such as Asia/Bangkok or America/New_York. Without it, times are in UTC.
